messages:
Marta G: Quick sync — launching Flywheel pilot (LangChain + our gateway + Orchestrator SI). Need a short runbook for marketplace listing + joint announce. Target soft-launch: Apr 7.
Jamal R: Good. Do we have final cert from infra on gateway auth flow?
Devon S: infra gave green last week but we need to confirm prod cert rotation and KMS policy for private deployments. I'll ping eng-infra.
Alex P: I'll own the marketplace listing assets (screenshots, short explainer, pricing tier). ETA Wed.
Elena M: Marketing wants a 1-paragraph partner blurb + 30s demo script by Fri for social.
Marta G: Sounds good. Core dependencies: 1) cert/KMS signoff (Devon) 2) SDK adapter docs (Alex) 3) SI runbook + contact list (Jamal) 4) Joint PR brief (Elena).
Jamal R: SI runbook draft — link: https://drive.internal/flywheel/sprint0 (internal). Key items: install adapter, sample prompt pipelines (LangChain + LlamaIndex), fallback routing to smaller quantized model.
Alex P: For SDK docs we need two code samples: 1) quickstart with LangChain loader 2) gateway-authenticated call. Draft snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# LangChain integration
chain = LangChain(llm=client.model('gpt-*-redwood'))
```
Elena M: Press/announce plan: internal embargo to partners Mar 31, partner preview Apr 3, soft-public Apr 7. Need partner-approved quote by Apr 1.
Devon S: Ops checklist I'm tracking: 
- cert rotation validated
- KMS roles applied
- VPC peering checklist complete
- Load test at 90th perc latency under SLO
I'll post results in this thread.
Marta G: Can we agree owners and deadlines? I'll summarize after this thread.
Jamal R: Owner list: Jamal -> SI runbook + contact; Alex -> SDK/docs + marketplace assets; Devon -> infra ops + perf tests; Elena -> PR brief + demo script; Marta -> rollout coordination + announcement timing.
Elena M: Also need a joint demo environment URL (non-prod) for partners. Ops: can we provide a sandbox token with scoped permissions?
Devon S: Yes, we can generate partner-scoped tokens. Will add generation steps to runbook.
partners-bot: Reminder: please fill in the partner onboarding form: https://forms.redwood/partner-onboard (deadline Mar 29).
Marta G: Minor ask — can we include an SI-authored migration note for customers switching from vendor X to our gateway? Helps reduce friction. Jamal can prod the SI.
Jamal R: On it. SI said they'll deliver a 1-page migration note + code diff by Mar 28.
Alex P: Marketplace asset checklist (short): 
- 1x hero screenshot (web UI)
- 1x architecture diagram (png)
- 1x short explainer (200 words)
- 2x code snippets (quickstart + auth)
- Pricing blurb (trial + paid)
I'll drop assets to the shared drive by Wed EOD.
Elena M: Demo script draft (30s): 
"Show: user query -> Orchestrator routes to LangChain pipeline -> Redwood gateway serves model -> Embedding store via LlamaIndex. Result in <1s on demo infra."
Marta G: Risks: SI delivery slip, marketplace review queue delay, infra perf flakiness under demo load. Contingency: postpone public announce 1 week or ship partner-only preview.
Devon S: I'll run a scaled smoke test Mon morning and post metrics. If error rate >1% we'll flag.
Marta G: Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: when you accept owners/deadlines. I'll compile and post final runbook Thu AM.
Alex P: :thumbsup:
Jamal R: :thumbsup:
Devon S: :thumbsup:
Elena M: :thumbsup:
Marta G: Thanks all — will follow up with a tidy runbook and timeline.
